context: Asuka lectures on classification, using formal alternatives.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; formal connectives (または/いわゆる/含め/自体) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 物事は、形または機能で分けられます。
lines.en: Things can be divided by form or function.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いわゆる分類、ということですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうです。いわゆる基本の考え方です。
lines.en: Yes — it's the so-called basic idea.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 例外も含めて、考える必要があります。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 言葉自体の意味も、関係しますか?
lines.en: Does the meaning of the word itself matter?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、言葉自体が、分類を左右します。
lines.en: Yes, the word itself shapes classification.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 色や音も、同様に分けられますね。
lines.en: Colors and sounds can be divided similarly.
lines.style: engaged adult student voice, soft warm understanding throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 同様の方法を、例外も含めて応用します。
lines.en: We apply the same method, including exceptions.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout
